svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Atlas Topology view with causal path (INC-2041)
svg.desc: Force-laid service graph of about 40 services grouped into team territories. The causal path gateway → checkout → payments → psp-api is highlighted: psp-api is the probable origin (full saturation, ⊕), upstream victims are desaturated with dashed rings, a ⚙ config change marker sits on payments at 12:19, edge particles are drawn as static dashes, and the Inspector shows why psp-api is ranked first.
